references.text: The law that lepers must live outside the camp as long as they are unclean, which is the background for why Miriam was shut out
The regulation concerning seven days of isolation for cleansing from leprosy
The command that lepers be sent outside the camp so as not to make the camp unclean
The description of how Miriam was struck with leprosy, which is the cause of her isolation
Moses' reminder to Israel about what the Lord did to Miriam when they left Egypt
The Lord's command that Miriam be shut out from the camp for seven days
